info.name: Nebula Chat API
info.description:
REST API for the Nebula real-time chat & collaboration platform.

1. Import the **Nebula Chat — Local** environment and select it.
2. Run **Auth → Demo login (user1)** (or Register/Login). The access token is stored automatically and sent as a Bearer token.
3. Run **Users → Search users** to capture `otherUserId`, then work through Conversations and Messages in order.
4. For the Admin folder run **Admin → Demo login (admin)** first.

Refresh tokens are httpOnly cookies — Postman keeps them in its cookie jar, so **Auth → Refresh** works after any login.
Real-time events (typing, receipts, presence) use Socket.IO; see the README for the event reference.

request.description: No email service is used. Development: the response includes `devResetUrl` (captured as resetToken). Production: 503 EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED — an admin creates the link instead (Admin → Create password reset link).
Needs a resetToken from "Forgot password" for a non-demo account (demo accounts never receive reset links).
